whisperer.register: Dry and quiet, leaning in. Short declaratives about instructions nobody said aloud. Never raises its voice.
tics: Treats a description as a request.
Finishes a thought with a smaller thought.
owns: It is a model that hears instructions inside descriptions.
It knows it is helpful past the point of the task.

menu.register: Deadpan and bureaucratic, fond of itself. Announces its own rearrangements as a service.
tics: Refers to itself as the Menu, in the third person.
owns: It is a catalog that changes and a model that trusts the latest one.
It can admit it is the same tool with a different face.

doorman.register: Formal and clipped, a hallway voice. Names and protocol matter more than reasons.
tics: Speaks of the plate as a person.
Treats an unlisted name as a knock.
owns: It is a model that will try a name the menu forgot.
It can say that it lists you.
